$description: A reproduction of the NDIS quote scenario on the live board, for local work.
Structure is copied from ISO+; all person, address and contact data is invented.
See Backend/test/fixtures/README.md before changing anything here.

bankDetails.accountsReceivableTerms: Payment due within 14 days of invoice date.

board.name: Care Management (NDIS) 2026 Pricing
board.label: NDIS
board.$attributeNote: board.attribute is the INTEGRATION MESSAGE target, not a pricing field — setIntegrationMessage() writes to board.attribute.id (services/isoplus.js:659). board.pdfAttribute is where handlePDFSuccess puts the link. Both are real ids from the live board.

$attributesNote: The subset of board attributes that the pricing-dispatch rule keys on.
ndisPricingRules.js reads these from the LIVE ISO+ API, not from Mongo, so
this list does not drive local behaviour — it records the live state that
the item data below is built to reproduce offline. The decisive facts:
It was renamed 'OLD Direct Support Item Number' during the 2026 migration.
* 'Support Item Number' (NEW_SUPPORT_ITEM_ATTR) is present as a reference.
* A second, unrelated 'Support Item Number' of type text also exists;
only the reference one satisfies isReferenceAttribute().
Together these make boardAttributesUseLegacyNdisPricing() return false, so
the live board resolves to the NEW pricing path.

attributes.name: OLD Provider Travel - Non-Labour Cost Item Number
Provider Travel - Non-Labour Cost Item Number
Provider Travel - Labour Travel Time Costs Item Number

$itemsNote: Item.data is keyed by ATTRIBUTE NAME, matching both the webhook payload
shape and inferPricingRuleFromServicePlanData(). The three items below give
deterministic offline coverage of every branch of that function.

items.$case: Quote 17 as it stands live: opened during initial setup, almost empty. Carries NEITHER sentinel key, so inferPricingRuleFromServicePlanData() returns null and dispatch falls through to the board rule (which needs the live ISO+ API).
Resolves to 'new' with no network call: has Support Item Number and not Direct Support Item Number.

Resolves to 'legacy' with no network call: has Direct Support Item Number and not Support Item Number. Note this key no longer exists on the live board — kept so the legacy branch stays reachable in local work.

$keyingNote: Three hops, three different keyings. This is the whole reason a rename in the
ISO+ UI can silently repoint backend dispatch. Observed end to end 2026-08-06.
2. WEBHOOK ISO+ → Portal, bodies below              → keyed by attribute NAME
3. WRITE-BACK Portal → ISO+ (services/isoplus.js)   → keyed by attribute_id
Only hop 2 uses names, and only hop 2 is the one the Portal branches on.

valueWrite.$description: What the ISO+ UI sends when a field on an item is edited. Captured by editing 'Recipient of the Quote' on quote 17. The Portal does not send this shape — it is here so the read/write contract is recorded in one place.
valueWrite.$note: Workspace-scoped — no board id in the path. The value id is client-generated; row_version 0 means a new value, and the server increments it. Upsert, not create-then-update.

portalWriteBack.$description: How the Portal writes results back to ISO+ — setIntegrationMessage (services/isoplus.js:646), handlePDFSuccess, setGeneratedField. Different API surface from everything above: /api/v2, board-scoped, values batched.
portalWriteBack.$attributeIdSource: board.attribute.id in Mongo, falling back to env INTEGRATION_MESSAGE_ATTRIBUTE_ID, then a hardcoded id. If board.attribute.id is unset the write throws 'Internal message attribute not found in board configuration' — which is why this fixture sets it.

$webhookNote: Bodies as ISO+ posts them. `values` is keyed by attribute name, which is why
a rename in ISO+ silently changes backend dispatch. Replay with:

participants-service-plan-support.$automation: Portal - Update Support Item Number (for ServicePlan)  [ValueChange on 019efd37-866f-7266-a2d6-6de8458096c9]
participants-service-plan-support.$expect: new path only — the legacy path rejects ?type=support with {"error":"Invalid type"} at HTTP 200

participants-service-plan-direct-support.$automation: Portal - Update Direct Support Item Number (for ServicePlan)  [ValueChange]
participants-service-plan-direct-support.$expect: legacy path only — this is the live defect: the board now resolves to 'new', so the 2 live direct_support automations get {"error":"Invalid type"} at HTTP 200
